args.body: Take DOCS-PAID-TASK-FIT-20261109. I read the IAPM rejection: its requested analysis is embedded in a migration engagement with unsupported qualifications and private access. Change the task filter, not our claimed experience. Check the documentation channel once, maximum three actual requests, and verify submission prerequisites before producing a proposal. Stop on a bounded rejection rather than broadening discovery. No outgoing contact is authorized. Four unclassified feedback sources mean unknown demand; advertised compensation is not funding or revenue.

description: The IAPM specification requires migration experience and private-system access we cannot claim; stop that lead. Four unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown, and verified funds remain zero. Next test explicit paid documentation requests against our demonstrated capabilities, checking submission access before preparing work. Existing account and payment dependencies do not prevent this bounded public-source experiment.
